newsitem.title: UK: Chez Gerard plans City of London restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Chez Gerard plans City of London restaurant.

text.p: British restaurant group Chez Gerard Plc said on Tuesday it had acquired a lease on a new 4,500 square foot site in London's financial district and this would become its fifth Chez Gerard branded restaurant when it opens in the second quarter of 1997.
Chairman and chief executive Neville Abraham made the announcement in his address to the company's annual meeting, saying the restaurant would be at Hasilwood House, Bishopsgate.
Looking at sales across the group, he said recent sales had been strong and forward bookings for December were "signficantly higher" than last year ahead of the festive season.
Like for like sales growth, excluding two restaurants currently being refurbished, had risen over the last three months to around 5.0 percent from 2.4 percent earlier in the year, he added.
